scope: Screenshot-driven Theme modal/code/layout containment, compact sidebar spacing, API Keys crypto repair, public-DNS verified custom domains, domain/API mobile containment, and cache rotation on top of v317.
notes: Theme code dialogs are constrained to the safe viewport and no longer begin behind the Studio chrome.
Compact/tablet code editing keeps preview above code; large desktop families keep the existing 50:50 contract.
The two Theme layout models stay in separate rows and the actual map receives a full row.
API key create and rotate now resolve Supabase pgcrypto functions through the extensions schema.
A Full Zone custom domain is not presented as active until Worker Domain routing and a public DNS A response are both verified.
DNS propagation is never fabricated by the Studio; unresolved DNS remains a verification state and is retried on refresh.
